name: LeadDesk Oy
summary: LeadDesk Oy operates as a cloud-based software company in Europe. The company also offers cloud services for high-volume sales and customer-service in the Nordic countries. In addition, it develops and supplies software for outbound sales, inbound sales, customer services, and pricing. The company serves customers in media, security service, energy, telecommunication, financial service, and market research industries. LeadDesk Oy was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
